author: Animan
description:
What if the weakest race in an isekai fantasy anime was secretly the strongest? In this anime analysis, we explore one of the smartest worldbuilding concepts ever created, featuring genius main characters, mind games, strategy, and overpowered intelligence instead of magic powers.

From psychological battles and game theory to fantasy worldbuilding and clever storytelling, this is why humanity being weak is actually the biggest advantage in this legendary isekai anime.
